validation.controlledModeChanged: Controlled mode cannot change while the control is mounted.
validation.incompatibleItems: The selection contains items incompatible with the configured type, category or extensions. Remove or replace them.
validation.invalidPolicy: Invalid selection type, category, extensions or limit configuration.
validation.selectionLimitExceeded: The selection exceeds the configured limit. Remove the extra items.

errors.configuration: Invalid picker configuration. Check the source, types, category and limits; use the preset without legacy options.
errors.auth-resource: The picker requested an authentication resource that is not allowed by the configuration.
errors.auth-type: The picker requested an authentication type that is not supported by the configuration.
errors.auth-challenge: The picker requires an additional authentication check that is not supported.
errors.auth-provider: Could not obtain the SharePoint token. Try again; if the problem persists, check your access and existing permissions.
errors.selection-identity: Could not verify the selected item's identity. Reopen the picker and try again.
errors.selection-scope: The selected item is outside the allowed site, library or folder.
errors.selection-policy: The selection does not meet the allowed type, category, extensions or item count.
errors.selection-unavailable: The selected item is unavailable or inaccessible.
errors.selection-invalid: Could not verify the selection. No new items were added.
errors.onedrive-unavailable: The current user's OneDrive is unavailable or inaccessible. Check that the drive exists and try again.
errors.opening: Could not open the picker. Check the configuration and access to the source, then try again.
errors.timeout: The picker did not respond in time. Close it and try again.
errors.communication: Communication with the picker was interrupted. Reopen it and try again.

protocol.optionalAuthenticationTimeout: The optional authentication feature did not respond in time. Try again.
protocol.unsupportedCommand: This integration does not support that command.
protocol.optionalGraphAuthenticationFailed: Could not authenticate the optional Microsoft Graph feature.
protocol.optionalPersonalAuthenticationFailed: Could not authenticate the optional personal destination.
